method: policy parameter search or explicitly recorded startup-action intervention; physics, clock and termination unchanged

hurdle_flight.recovery_definition: First >=2.3 m/game-s over 0.2 s torso displacement, sustained 15 frames (0.5 s), measured from first foot-contact frame after main hurdle flight.
hurdle_flight.relative_recovery_definition: Mean 0.5 s torso-displacement speed over score 40--45 m is the reference; first >=90% of reference on 0.5 s torso-displacement speed sustained 15 frames, from first foot-contact frame after hurdle cycle.

measurement_notes: Original game clock and original score; 30 frames/game second, 400 world reference units/race meter.
Flat-running posture mask fixed at score 10--45 m and 65--90 m for every checkpoint.
Torso height is a proxy, not mass-weighted center of mass. No knee-contact API is available.

Flight defined by neither foot contacting ground for >=3 frames. Hurdle cycle is highest-torso flight starting by 0.5 s after the torso crosses the obstacle, ending no earlier than 0.2 s before crossing; it need not be a deliberate jump.

note: Best candidate is exactly unchanged source NN; saved file is an experimental duplicate, not a faster learned model
